SELECT CONVERT(DATE, STOCK_DATE) AS STOCK_DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(MATERIAL_CODE)) AS MATERIAL_CODE, SUM(AVAILABLE_STOCK) AS AVAILABLE_STOCK FROM MES_CD15_STOCK WHERE STOCK_DATE IS NOT NULL AND MATERIAL_CODE IS NOT NULL AND AVAILABLE_STOCK IS NOT NULL
AND CONVERT(DATE, STOCK_DATE) = CONVERT(DATE, #{queryParams.stockDate})
AND CONVERT(DATE, STOCK_DATE) = CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE())
GROUP BY CONVERT(DATE, STOCK_DATE), LTRIM(RTRIM(MATERIAL_CODE))

SELECT CONVERT(DATE, STOCK_DATE) AS STOCK_DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(MATERIAL_CODE)) AS MATERIAL_CODE, SUM(AVAILABLE_STOCK) AS AVAILABLE_STOCK FROM MES_CD15_STOCK WHERE STOCK_DATE IS NOT NULL AND MATERIAL_CODE IS NOT NULL AND AVAILABLE_STOCK IS NOT NULL AND CONVERT(DATE, STOCK_DATE) = CONVERT(DATE, #{stockDate}) GROUP BY CONVERT(DATE, STOCK_DATE), LTRIM(RTRIM(MATERIAL_CODE))
